# Axis Labs

> Axis Labs is a mobile application studio designing, building, and publishing products across productivity, finance, gaming, and education.

## Apps

- [AI Sabotage](https://axislabs.eu/ai-sabotage): Cyberpunk card game about building AGI and sabotaging rivals.
- [DriveCam](https://axislabs.eu/drivecam): Smart dashcam app turning your phone into an intelligent driving recorder.
- [My Rents](https://axislabs.eu/my-rents): Rental property income, expense, and tenant management app.
- [Home Handy](https://axislabs.eu/home-handy): Home maintenance organizer, task scheduler, and appliance tracker.
- [Tandapp](https://axislabs.eu/tandapp): Community savings and tanda coordination app for private groups.
- [The Impostor](https://axislabs.eu/the-impostor): Fast-paced social deduction party game for groups and gatherings.
- [Party Words](https://axislabs.eu/party-words): Dynamic party word-guessing game for friends and family.
- [MyHoldings](https://axislabs.eu/myholdings): Personal asset portfolio and net worth tracker.
- [TimeTap](https://axislabs.eu/timetap): Precision timing and reaction speed arcade game.
- [Mind Your Math](https://axislabs.eu/mind-your-math): Speed arithmetic and mental math brain training game.
- [Horas Extras](https://axislabs.eu/horas-extras): Overtime and working hours tracker with rate calculations.
- [Lucra](https://axislabs.eu/lucra): Smart investment portfolio and dividend tracking application.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://axislabs.eu/privacy): Axis Labs privacy notice for website visitors and mobile app users.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://axislabs.eu/terms): Terms of service and conditions for using Axis Labs website and applications.

## Blog

- [Blog](https://axislabs.eu/blog): Mobile engineering, app marketing, and open-source tooling articles.
- [Why We Build Every App with Flutter](https://axislabs.eu/blog/why-we-build-with-flutter): How choosing Flutter enables single-codebase development for Android, iOS, and macOS, compared with native and React Native.
- [Every App Deserves Its Own Website](https://axislabs.eu/blog/every-app-deserves-its-own-website): How dedicated marketing websites and targeted SEO drive organic downloads for mobile applications.
- [Open-Source Tools We Built for Our Apps](https://axislabs.eu/blog/open-source-tools-for-our-apps): Overview of open-source tools including rewarded_ad_counter (Flutter monetization on pub.dev) and companies-scraper (outbound B2B lead generation).
